card.name: Protective or counteracting effect phrasing
card.fires_on: Small linking words and word parts inside sentences about one agent protecting against or opposing another's effect, such as 'protects against NSAID-induced ulcers by'. Also fires inside nitric oxide donor and drug interaction phrases.

modes.label: Protects against harm
modes.description: Words in a sentence saying a herb or drug protects against drug-induced damage, especially the word 'by' before the mechanism.
modes.example: Corydalis also protects against NSAID-induced gastric and duodenal ulcers<< by>> reducing gastric acid secretion.10

modes.label: Interaction wording
modes.description: Linking words or drug-name parts in sentences about one drug antagonizing or adding to another, including nitric oxide donors.
modes.example: Aspirin Salicylates antagonize<< the>> uricosuric action of drugs used
